items.coder_A: sargramostim as vaccine adjuvant; could be a candidate
items.proposed: not a candidate; has_eligible_candidate false, excluded_intervention_type (agreed coding stands)
items.reason: Sargramostim is given 'at the site of the first injection' to boost the immune response to SurVaxM, i.e. a GM-CSF adjuvant supporting a vaccine, which R4 names explicitly. It has no arm or outcome of its own (Arm B replaces vaccine and sargramostim together with placebo).

items.coder_B: only investigational agent is the vaccine; sargramostim coded with vaccine
items.proposed: not a candidate; excluded_intervention_type (agreed coding stands)
items.reason: R4: GM-CSF/sargramostim given to support a vaccine is part of the excluded therapy unless tested in its own right, which it is not here.

note: Excluded at S6 (peptide vaccine). Priority-3 target_engagement: vaccine immune responses concern the excluded vaccine, not a candidate, so 'no'. MGMT/IDH results must only be 'available', not a required status, so not selection biomarkers.
